sv.title: Flera döda efter brand i Phuket
sv.summary: Minst elva personer har dött och flera skadats efter en stor brand i en affärslokal i Phuket i Thailand.

en.title: Several dead after fire in Phuket
en.summary: At least eleven people have died and several have been injured after a large fire in a retail premises in Phuket, Thailand.
